تقترحن (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِحْنَ (taqtariḥna) /taq.ta.riħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# تُقْتَرَحْنَ (tuqtaraḥna) /tuq.ta.raħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
